# Fidelity index

Every GGUF file Runner has scored against its publisher's reference weights, one row per measurement, pass or fail. A row reads one file against the reference checkpoint at the revision named, over the window named; the verdict is the bar of the fidelity method, mean KLD at most 0.05 and margin-qualified top-1 at least 97%, which was set over 2,000 positions, so a row over fewer positions is a smaller sample read against the same numbers. Failing rows come first. A side whose report does not say which file it scored is listed as not identified rather than left out.

**269 measured sides in 181 reports: 140 pass, 129 fail; the files of 230 are not identified.** Method: [fidelity-method.md](fidelity-method.md).
